style: Ultra-realistic luxury product photography, like a high-end Swiss watch campaign. Ivory-white technical ceramic, black anodised aluminium and brushed steel, with warm champagne-gold rim light from the upper left, deep velvety espresso-brown shadows, fine film grain, crisp machined edges. No text, no letters, no numbers, no logos, no watermark.

items.name: hero-burr
items.prompt: Perfectly top-down orthographic view straight down the axis of a professional espresso machine's FLAT ceramic burr grinding head, one perfect circle centered on a pure black background, filling about 90% of the frame. From outside in: a black anodised housing ring with a very fine external gear-tooth edge, a thin black rubber gasket, then the ivory-white ceramic flat burr ring (like the attached reference) with dozens of radial cutting teeth and a few deeper feed grooves sweeping toward the centre, then a dark inner throat with a brushed steel rotor hub and three small screw heads at the exact centre. A light dusting of espresso grounds on the teeth. Strong radial symmetry, jewel-like, premium.

items.name: burr-macro
items.prompt: Extreme macro of a flat ivory-white ceramic coffee burr ring, like the attached reference, seen from a low three-quarter angle: sharp radial cutting teeth and deeper feed grooves in matte technical ceramic, a few espresso-fine coffee grounds resting on the teeth, subject centered, warm dark background.

items.name: dial-macro
items.prompt: Macro of the black anodised burr housing of a professional espresso grinder, like the attached reference: a fine external gear ring that a small motor uses to set the grind, machined grooves, and a sliver of ivory ceramic burr visible inside, centered circular composition, warm dark background.

items.name: cooling-fins
items.prompt: Exploded view floating in dark space, like the attached reference: two ivory-white flat ceramic burr rings hovering above a polished steel rotor carrier with three claw arms and a central bearing, a thin black gasket ring above them. Elegant, centered, technical.
